title: HuMiT: Low-Latency Whole-Body Humanoid Teleoperation via Compact Reference Tracking
title_zh: HuMiT：基于紧凑参考跟踪的低延迟全身人形机器人遥操作
abstract: Real-time whole-body humanoid teleoperation remains challenging due to the computational latency introduced by optimization-based retargeting pipelines and future-frame conditioning. Existing motion tracking policies typically require dense reference targets including full joint positions, body-part transformations, and even future frames, which tightly couples the controller to expensive upstream modules. In this work, we present HuMiT, a whole-body teleoperation system built on a unified tracking policy that requires only a compact reference target, consisting of root height, root velocity, and the SE(3) poses of four sparse keypoints at the current frame, yet achieves competitive tracking fidelity compared to methods relying on more diverse reference states including complete joint positions, dense body-part transformations, and even future frames. Experiments show that our policy achieves a communication-to-inference latency of $\sim$20 ms measured between headset streaming and policy output and a video-based optical flow latency of 65 ms (median) across different motion types. We validate the system on a Unitree G1 humanoid, showcasing split-second reactive responses such as catching a tossed ball, as well as coordinated loco-manipulation capabilities. Project page: https://xiaohu-art.github.io/Track/.
abstract_zh: 实时全身人形机器人遥操作仍面临挑战，因为基于优化的重定向流程和未来帧条件引入了计算延迟。现有的运动跟踪策略通常需要密集的参考目标，包括完整的关节位置、身体部位变换甚至未来帧，这使得控制器与昂贵的上游模块紧密耦合。在本工作中，我们提出了 HuMiT，一个全身遥操作系统，基于统一的跟踪策略，仅需一个紧凑的参考目标，由当前帧的根高度、根速度和四个稀疏关键点的 SE(3) 位姿组成，却能达到与依赖更多样参考状态（包括完整关节位置、密集身体部位变换甚至未来帧）的方法相媲美的跟踪保真度。实验表明，我们的策略在头显流传输和策略输出之间实现了约 20 毫秒的通信到推理延迟，以及在不同运动类型下基于视频的光流延迟为 65 毫秒（中位数）。我们在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上验证了系统，展示了诸如接住抛来的球等瞬间反应能力，以及协调的移动操作能力。项目页面：https://xiaohu-art.github.io/Track/。
tldr_zh: HuMiT 仅用稀疏关键点实现低延迟全身人形遥操作。
cover_zh: 仅需四个关键点！人形机器人遥操作延迟低至20ms
